name: Omni-Ubiquity Net
description: A net that has been modified once again by Wakamurasaki using onmyoudou. She claims that it can detain the essence of small creatures before using the net itself as a medium to recreate their forms.
fullDescription: A net created using onmyoudou. It can be used to detain the essences of small animals and also serves as a medium to recreate their forms. There exists a training ground somewhere in Inazuma that uses onmyoudou to recreate monsters and villains. The technique used to make these nets may be the product of those same techniques following many long years of degradation in power and knowledge.
